properties.name: ratchet.schema.auto-migrate
properties.description: Prepare Ratchet SQL schemas or MongoDB collections and indexes. False validates read-only.

properties.name: ratchet.batch.max-partitions
properties.description: Maximum number of partitions per set; at least one.

properties.name: ratchet.batch.partition-grace
properties.description: Positive grace before canceling incomplete partition generations.
